invariant_statement: A-E are classical arithmetic functions determined by their action on prime powers with a fixed composition rule (additive or multiplicative over coprime arguments): A ~ sopfr (completely additive sum of prime factors with multiplicity); B ~ sum of distinct prime factors (strongly additive); C ~ bigomega / count with multiplicity (completely additive); D ~ omega / count distinct (strongly additive); E ~ tau = number of divisors (multiplicative). F6 is predicted to be the remaining canonical member of this family: sigma = sum of divisors, multiplicative, sigma(p^k) = (p^(k+1)-1)/(p-1).
